items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: So Harry and Betty Grable adopted Corky Corcoran so he could stay in the band

ctx.x: That’s sort of like a basketball team. Like you’ve been traded man.

Oh yeah I know. No it’s the same thing. Now Corky’s telling me this and we’re breaking up. So Corky says, so now, in those days you did movies, you know they put the bands in movies. People wouldn’t care about the movie, they’d want to go see the band, right? So we still do music from this, the worst motion picture in the world, Saving — no, not “Saving Private Ryan” no, “Private Buckaroo.” Awful movie. It has the Andrews Sisters, has one of the — has Joe E. Lewis the comedian, and Harry James. And Harry James is…

This is not a question but an observation. I watched a video of the band with you and took note of the song that had a singer and how the band played the tune and then it modulated for the singer. Not a question, I think it’s just an interesting thing, because I know it was fairly common for the arrangers to do that. And it was musically a good decision, sometimes a practical decision. The band sounds better in this key, the singer sings better in this key.
